said.t: Det kræver 61 mandater for at opnå et flertal i Israels parlament, Knesset, og begge blokke var dermed afhængige af de resterende 19 mandater, der gik til Israels arabiske partier.
Det betyder, at Eisenkot og hans parti, Yashar, har opbakning fra 67 af de i alt 120 medlemmer af Knesset.
Partier med i alt 46 medlemmer af Knesset anbefalede Benjamin Netanyahu fra Likud-partiet, mens ét parti med syv medlemmer valgte ikke at anbefale nogen, lyder det fra præsidentens kontor.
Når præsidenten har bedt et medlem af Knesset om at danne regering, har vedkommende 28 dage til at danne en ny regering.
Hvis der er behov for mere tid, har præsidenten bemyndigelse til at give en forlængelse på op til 14 dage.
66-årige Eisenkot er søn af marokkanske indvandrere og gik først ind i politik i 2022, skriver nyhedsbureauet Reuters.
Eisenkot’s wide-ranging opposition bloc won 48 of the Israeli parliament’s 120 seats in October elections, while Netanyahu’s camp secured 53, leaving neither with a majority.
During party consultations with Herzog, 66-year-old Eisenkot received the endorsements of both Arab-majority lists, who could now play kingmakers after making unprecedented gains in the vote.

Gaza’s Ministry of Social Development has warned of an impending humanitarian catastrophe, estimating that more than 300,000 families urgently require adequate shelter.

According to the ministry, the territory needs approximately 200,000 new weather-resistant tents and 300,000 emergency shelter kits containing thermal insulation materials, tarpaulins and reinforced plastic sheeting.

The shelter crisis has been compounded by extensive destruction across the Gaza Strip, where approximately 85 percent of residential units have reportedly been completely or partially damaged, leaving displaced families with few alternatives to overcrowded camps and temporary shelters.
